title: Chapter 253 Attacking Nanshan Group
content:
Chapter 253 Attacking Nanshan Group

After returning to the lord's mansion, other lords sent people to exchange supplies.

Some lords also sent out some hundred-man teams to temporarily join Wang Shuo's army. This was what they agreed yesterday.

In order to prevent Wang Shuo from using these soldiers as cannon fodder, Wang Shuo had to pay a high pension for each death.

Wang Shuo had no objection to this, just treating them as mercenaries!

Two days later, everything was ready.

The number of flaming war horses was insufficient to supply the golden fire cavalry, which made Wang Shuo a little regretful.

If some cavalry were allowed to ride on flaming war horses, the speed of the cavalry would inevitably be out of sync, which would affect their combat effectiveness.

At the same time, the number of warhorse armor was not enough. After Wang Shuo and Ayub discussed it, they also had no equipment.

Wang Shuo gathered 6,000 troops for this expedition.

Among them, there were 4,300 people in the Red Flame Army, and the remaining 1,700 people were the 100-man battalions sent by each of the 13 lords. Some lords directly sent 200 to 300 people, which was very respectful to Wang Shuo. Wang Shuo incorporated them into the alliance army, which was considered a ragtag army.

Among them, Ayub's direct Golden Fire Cavalry had 800 people, Good's Archer Cavalry had 500 people, Gong Zheng's Shield Soldiers had 500 people, Gong Ping's Black Mountain Bandits had 500 people, Gong Kai's Archers had 500 people, Li Jianguo's Crossbow Artillery Soldiers had 500 people, Li Weiguo's Sword Guards had 500 people, and Li Baoguo's Spear Soldiers had 500 people.

Seeing the mighty army on the square, Wang Shuo was shocked.

After a simple morale boost, the army set out and headed towards Nanshanji.

Because there were more infantry, the marching speed was not fast.

Nanshanji got the news soon.

After hearing the news, Lin Guanru was quite surprised!

He didn't expect that someone would dare to attack him.

Although he didn't think that a small village could capture his Nanshanji, it was a serious contempt for his authority.

If he couldn't defeat it cleanly this time, he would definitely become a joke in the eyes of the city lords and mayors.

"Immediately call the leaders of each gang to come to discuss!" Lin Guanru said loudly to the leader Wutuk beside him.

Soon, Ni Wu, Zhuge Kewei, Yue Ji, Ladul and others came to the lord's mansion.

The reason why Ladul was qualified to sit here was because he established a Blood Axe Mercenary Group in Nanshanji, which had a very rapid development momentum and had become one of the top ten gangs in Nanshanji, and even broke out the title of "Blood Axe Ladul".

"Everyone, I just got the news that Wang Shuo, the lord of Wana Village, actually organized an army and wanted to attack our Nanshan Village. What do you think?"

Ni Wu took the lead and said, "Mr. Town Mayor, I am willing to be the vanguard and defeat the invading enemy."

Ni Wu actually knew that Wang Shuo would come to attack Nanshan Village. There was a traitor among the lords who went to the alliance, but Ni Wu did not tell Lin Guanru about this news.

This is a rare opportunity. As long as Wang Shuo and Lin Guanru both lose, he can reap the benefits.

"Commander Ni is thoughtful. Do other gang leaders have any ideas?"

"I am willing to follow the arrangements of the town mayor and defeat the invading enemy."

"I am willing to go out of the city and bring the heads of the rebels to you."

...

One by one, the leaders expressed their opinions.

Lin Guanru smiled and nodded. At least it seemed that everyone was working together.

As for how many were sincere, he certainly knew.

He himself was more inclined to defend the city.

Right now, what he relies on most is naturally his 1,000 guards. If they defend with all their strength, he will not be afraid of the invading enemy at all.
